stories.title: Can Texas bounce back? Will the Big 12 go sideways? Connelly on an eventful Week 6
stories.summary: Georgia is in great shape, but what about Alabama? And what's up with Texas and the ever-fluid hot seat?

stories.title: WNBA Finals location for Dream home games still uncertain
stories.summary: The Dream, dealing with conflicting events at State Farm Arena, are still determining where they will play their home games during the upcoming WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Source: Shipley latest Eagles RB likely to miss time, has plantar fascia tear
stories.summary: Eagles running back Will Shipley suffered a partial tear of his plantar fascia during Sunday's loss to the Jaguars that now could sideline him multiple weeks, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

stories.title: Michigan sticking with Underwood as QB1, OC Beck as playcaller
stories.summary: Michigan coach Kyle Whittingham says the Wolverines are sticking with Bryce Underwood as starting quarterback and offensive coordinator Jason Beck will continue to call plays.

stories.title: Alabama WR Coleman-Williams unlikely to play vs. Vols, says DeBoer
stories.summary: Alabama star receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams is unlikely to play at Tennessee on Saturday due to multiple injuries, according to coach Kalen DeBoer.
